blocks.explanation:
Do fixed angles ke tangents ka farq hai aur jawab \(2\sqrt{3}\) dikhana hai, table ke baghair.
Is exercise ke formulas sine aur cosine ke liye hain, tangent ke liye nahi. Is liye pehle tan ko \(\frac{\sin}{\cos}\) mein badalna parega.
Plan: ek fraction banayein; upar \(\sin(75^{\circ} - 15^{\circ})\) banega aur neeche \(\cos 75^{\circ}\cos 15^{\circ}\) product formula se nikalega.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \tan 75^{\circ} - \tan 15^{\circ}\).
Saabit karna hai: L.H.S. \(= 2\sqrt{3}\).
Tareeqa: \(\tan\theta = \frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}\), \(\sin(\alpha - \beta)\) wala formula, aur \(2\cos\alpha\cos\beta = \cos(\alpha + \beta) + \cos(\alpha - \beta)\).

Ek fraction banayein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{\sin 75^{\circ}}{\cos 75^{\circ}} - \dfrac{\sin 15^{\circ}}{\cos 15^{\circ}}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sin 75^{\circ}\cos 15^{\circ} - \cos 75^{\circ}\sin 15^{\circ}}{\cos 75^{\circ}\cos 15^{\circ}}\]
Kyun: Do fractions ka farq lene ke liye common denominator chahiye, bilkul \(\frac{a}{b} - \frac{c}{d} = \frac{ad - bc}{bd}\) ki tarah.

Numerator
\[\sin 75^{\circ}\cos 15^{\circ} - \cos 75^{\circ}\sin 15^{\circ}\]
\[= \sin(75^{\circ} - 15^{\circ}) = \sin 60^{\circ} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
Kyun: Yeh bilkul \(\sin(\alpha - \beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta - \cos\alpha\sin\beta\) ka right side hai. Isay pehchanna hi is sawal ki chaabi hai.

Denominator
\[\cos 75^{\circ}\cos 15^{\circ} = \dfrac{1}{2}(\cos 90^{\circ} + \cos 60^{\circ})\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}\left(0 + \dfrac{1}{2}\right) = \dfrac{1}{4}\]
Kyun: Product formula: \(75^{\circ} + 15^{\circ} = 90^{\circ}\), \(75^{\circ} - 15^{\circ} = 60^{\circ}\). \(\cos 90^{\circ} = 0\) aur \(\cos 60^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\). Aage \(\frac{1}{2}\) us 2 ka hai jo formula mein hota hai.

Divide karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}/2}{1/4}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\times 4 = 2\sqrt{3} = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{4}\) se divide karna 4 se multiply karne ke barabar hai.
Dhyan dein: Fraction ko fraction se divide karte waqt neeche wale ko ulta kar ke multiply karein.
